title: SILENT HILL: Townfall
verified: 2026-10-01 against a real save (Unreal Engine 5.6, GVAS, property-tag layout 1017); story rules 2026-10-01 against the owner's save (missions 1, 3, 5, 6 Completed, 7 Active)

From Scratch.why: Create 20 new items by combining others. ProfileData keeps a lifetime count of crafted items.

Fleeting Visit.why: Finish the game in under 4 hours. TimePlayed_TotalRecord is the best whole-game time in seconds, -1 until a playthrough is finished (mission records beside it are seconds too).

Welcome To St. Amelia.why: Escape the Otherworld and return to the town square: chapter 1 ends in mission 3 (cinematic 07 'Escape safe room').

Resignation.why: At the Shorefront Family Clinic, show Zoe you understand: chapter 2. Mission 6 holds the last chapter 2 cinematic (15, Watching Zoe's Transmission) and the first of chapter 3 (Being Zoe).

A Long Night Ahead.why: Report to Dr. Glenn at the Medical Centre: mission 10 opens with cinematic 21 'Journey to Medical'.

The Patient.why: Tend to the Patient: mission 40, cinematic 26 'Zoe The Patient, Inside Surgery'.

Many Into One.why: Accept the transfusion in the Alternate Medical Centre: after The Patient and before Key To The Castle (Steam 35 percent between 44 and 29), so certainly done once mission 13 is.

Key To The Castle.why: Unlock the path to CEG Tower: the game's sequence SEQ_Mission13_CEG_GateOpen is in mission 13.

Find Yourself.why: Make it back to the office on the 10th floor: mission 17, cinematic 41 'FY'.

Can't Change Things.why: Exhaust the options in the Alternate Facility: before Eraser (Steam 20.8 against 20.7), so certainly done once mission 23 is.

Eraser.why: Defeat The Weight: mission 23, cinematic 52 'Eraser, Giving Up'.

not_mapped.story: Mission order comes from the developer saves the game ships (Content/Townfall/Debug/DevSaves/Mission<N>/PCUTSCENE <k> - ID <cinematic> - <initials>), whose cinematic ids run 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 10, 40, 11, 12, 13, 14, 8, 17, 18, 21, 23, 29; cinematic names carry the chapter (Cin_Ch02_EnteringShorefrontClinic). Steam's global rates fall in an unbroken line (88, 65, 57, 44, 35, 29, 24, 21, 21 percent), so every story achievement is required, not a choice. Where the exact mission is unsure, the rule waits for the latest mission certain to contain it: late, never early. Endings are not mapped: they are a bitmask whose bit order is not known.
not_mapped.Lured Off Track: The save counts enemies distracted by any thrown object (bottles and bricks); the achievement needs bottles.
not_mapped.Static Distractions: The save counts noise makers and environmental distractions; neither is known to be the radios.
not_mapped.Cold Calling: Calls are a bitmask; the number of phone numbers in the game is not known.
not_mapped.endings: Endings are a bitmask; which bit is which ending is not known.
